description: This file is a Cypress test suite for smoke and accessibility testing of the Stock Insights Analyzer web application. It contains multiple test cases that visit different pages, verify page content, and check accessibility compliance.

methods.name: loads dashboard and has no critical a11y violations
methods.description: Test that visits the dashboard page, checks for specific content, and runs accessibility checks.

methods.name: search page loads and filters UI is reachable
methods.description: Test that visits the search page, verifies the search input is present, and runs accessibility checks.

methods.name: portfolio page loads
methods.description: Test that visits the portfolio page and checks for specific content.

methods.name: settings page loads
methods.description: Test that visits the settings page and verifies specific content.

methods.name: help page loads
methods.description: Test that visits the help page and verifies specific content.
